Veterans Benefits: Massachusetts fully excludes U.S. military retirement pensions from state gross income. Eligible veterans may also receive local property-tax exemptions based on qualifying service or service-connected disability, with additional municipal options under current Massachusetts law.
Description: Quincy is a dense, historic South Shore city just south of Boston with a VA clinic inside city limits and a General Dynamics Mission Systems facility (autonomous underwater vehicles, on the site of the former Fore River shipyard). Crime runs somewhat above the national average, and 2024 saw a noticeable Republican shift versus 2016, consistent with broader trends in the city's diverse working- and middle-class neighborhoods.
